final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), stats AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS all_college_avg, SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count FROM college_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT player_count FROM college_counts, stats WHERE player_count > all_college_avg) SELECT AVG(above_avg.player_count) AS above_avg_colleges_average_player_count, AVG(1.0 * above_avg.player_count / stats.total_player_count) AS average_fraction_of_total, AVG(above_avg.player_count - stats.all_college_avg) AS average_excess_over_all_college_average FROM above_avg CROSS JOIN stats
